title: Spain Galicia Crop fields
description:
**Galician Crop Fields**: The Geographic Information System for Agricultural Plots (SIXPAC) is an official reference database for the identification of agricultural plots, which is mandatory in Spain for making applications for direct CAP aid that require declaring surface areas.
SIXPAC information is relevant to farmers applying for these aid schemes, so that they can indicate the location of the farm surfaces that may be eligible for subsidies, as well as to facilitate the submission of requests for changes to data relating to land uses contained in the system.

This collection holds 13 editions (2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_ga/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2026). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:4326). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_ga/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

table:columns.name: crop:name
table:columns.description: Crop name in the original language. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin_province_code
table:columns.description: Province code (source column `PROVINCIA`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin_municipality_code
table:columns.description: Municipal code (source column `MUNICIPIO`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Spain Galicia — latest edition (2026) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2026/es_ga-2026.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.1, 0.25 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
